answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil swarms via synchronized memory-hard puzzles tied to a randomness beacon. At the zenith of each epoch, agents get a seed and must return a gigabyte-scale Equihash solution within a strict latency delta to earn a violet credential. That tight deadline blocks time-sharing one DRAM bank across clones, forcing attackers to fund dedicated physical RAM and power per key. However, adversaries can still rent cloud spot fleets or use botnets during those brief checks.
